content.comment_body: Hello, quick question. Is it possible for a [product_name] to work with distributed I/O? Specifically, can I connect a [product_name] to something like a [product_name] distributed I/O module? Thanks, [user_name]
No, the [product_name] can only be connected to devices using the [version_no] protocol (such as certain operator panels or controllers). It does not support bus systems like Profibus or equivalents.
Take a look at this as an additional resource: [url]

analysis.insight_summary: Participants are looking to extend the functionality of the [product_name] device by integrating it with distributed I/O modules like [product_name] distributed I/O units. Responses clearly indicate a limitation: [product_name] does not support bus protocols such as Profibus and can only connect to devices using the [version_no] protocol. This demonstrates a lack of flexibility for expanding [product_name] systems with advanced I/O capabilities.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect the [product_name] to easily integrate with distributed I/O systems, particularly [product_name] distributed I/O modules.
